title: Make approval requests atomic and idempotent across concurrent Fleet handoffs
description: Owner79720701 observed actual duplicate Kernel101fe731/Manager6f85e138 and Runtime925643d6/Manager99ef7a45 exact recovery requests. Record one proposed existing-backlog requirement, not a competing approval queue: atomic durable request idempotency keyed project/task/exact candidate/action/resource set/named approver. Preserve each request attempt and evidence lineage, return one actionable request identity to concurrent callers, and keep meaningful evidence/scope conflicts explicit. Current existing approvals and rejected-as-superseded histories remain unchanged. Manager queries existing requests before creating; this procedural precheck does not solve races. Implementation unassigned pending reliability sequence, domain ownership, peer consent and QA; no new authority/provider starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent identical requests at the durable boundary resolve one actionable approval ID without losing attempt/evidence audit; key includes project, task, exact candidate, action, canonical resource set and named approver.
Different candidates, approvers, actions or resource scopes remain distinct; incompatible evidence revisions are visible and cannot silently broaden an existing decision.
Named approver authority, evidence sufficiency, revision checks, pause and ownership controls remain enforced; deduplication never approves, executes or transfers ownership.
Interrupted request creation/retry returns the existing durable outcome with no second actionable pending or approved request, retaining superseded historical records.
Independent deterministic concurrency/recovery scenarios observe durable request IDs, evidence lineage and refusals at API/CLI boundaries; no weakening of existing approval assertions.
